top_signals.title: European Gas Heads for Fourth Weekly Gain as Iran War Drags On
top_signals.summary: European natural gas headed for a fourth weekly gain as fresh fighting in the Middle East boosted concerns about prolonged supply disruptions and winter fuel inventories.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Economists See Final ECB Rate Hike Next Week
top_signals.summary: Economists think the European Central Bank will raise interest rates next week but not beyond that. The majority of respondents in a Bloomberg survey expect the deposit rate to be raised by a quarter-point to 2.5% on Thursday and stay there through 2027. The survey results point toward a far more dovish outcome than markets are currently betting on. Bloomberg's Jana Randow breaks down the situation. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Jokowi’s Legacy of Debt May Curb Danantara’s Investment Ambition
top_signals.summary: The financial strain facing some of Indonesia’s biggest state-owned construction firms, rooted in former President Joko Widodo’s infrastructure drive, risks forcing current leader Prabowo Subianto’s sovereign wealth fund Danantara to spend more to overhaul them, potentially limiting its ability to pursue new investments.

top_signals.title: VW Approves Plan for 50,000 Additional Job Cuts
top_signals.summary: Volkswagen's supervisory board backed a restructuring that calls for 50,000 additional job cuts, far fewer models and a smaller industrial footprint. The new staff cuts represent about 8% of VW’s global workforce as of the end of last year. Bloomberg's Danny Lee reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
